title: Design an Atomic Payment Ledger & Reservation Engine Preventing TOCTOU Races
prompt: Design a payment reservation and double-entry ledger service handling 25K concurrent debits/sec across 10M accounts with zero negative-balance TOCTOU races, strict idempotency on client retries, and full auditability.

spark.summary: Combine an atomic `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT` idempotency gate with single-statement conditional `UPDATE` + version CAS and an immutable double-entry ledger table.
spark.keyTakeaway: When traffic spikes expose hidden coupling, execute balance check, version increment, and idempotency claim inside one short local ACID transaction—never across external RPCs.
spark.byteSummary:
At 25K debits/sec, naive `SELECT balance` followed by application-side `if balance >= amount` and `UPDATE` leaks millions during mobile retry storms and flash sales.

The hardened architecture enforces three atomic layers: (1) an `Idempotency-Key` table claimed via `INSERT ... ON CONFLICT DO NOTHING` + SHA-256 payload hash check; (2) a single conditional `UPDATE ledger_accounts SET balance = balance - :amt, version = version + 1 WHERE id = :id AND balance >= :amt AND version = :v`; and (3) an append-only `ledger_entries` insert in the same local PostgreSQL transaction.

Hot merchant accounts that exceed single-row lock throughput are sharded into `K` sub-buckets (`merchant_id#0..K-1`) and reconciled asynchronously.

decisionFramework.problem: How to implement Design an Atomic Payment Ledger & Reservation Engine Preventing TOCTOU Races without hitting unbounded tail latency, state divergence, or operational fragility.
decisionFramework.naiveSolution: Use a single unpartitioned path with unbounded retries and synchronous global coordination.
decisionFramework.whyItFails: Global coordination serializes throughput under load, while unbounded retries amplify transient stalls into full outages.
decisionFramework.alternatives: Compare synchronous strict-consistency paths against bounded asynchronous replication, local caching, or partitioned ownership.
decisionFramework.decision: When traffic spikes expose hidden coupling, execute balance check, version increment, and idempotency claim inside one short local ACID transaction—never across external RPCs.
decisionFramework.tradeOffs: Gains predictable p99 latency and fault isolation in exchange for explicit bounding, observability, and slightly higher implementation complexity.

prerequisites.title: TOCTOU Race Conditions & Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS)
prerequisites.summary: Time-of-Check to Time-of-Use (TOCTOU) race conditions occur when state validated in step 1 changes before step 2 mutates it; Atomic Compare-And-Swap (CAS) closes the gap in a single indivisible operation.

prerequisites.title: Optimistic Concurrency Control
prerequisites.summary: A lock-free concurrency pattern that lets readers and writers proceed without blocking, validating at commit time via a version number or ETag that no one else modified the record.

prerequisites.title: Deadlock Detection & Prevention
prerequisites.summary: Identifying and resolving circular wait conditions—where two or more threads or database transactions hold locks each other needs—via wait-for graph cycle detection, timeouts, or canonical lock ordering.
